Name: ModConverter
Author: saldasdron
Description:
This program will create a manifest.json and content.json file so you don't have to.
You will have to see for yourself if this is any usefull but it certainly saved me alot of time.

[b][size=4]Note:[/size]

[/b]For this to work as intended, your content pack has to contain a [font=Arial][b]Content[/b][/font] folder that follows the structure of  [font=Courier New]\Stardew Valley\Content[/font].
The generated manifest.json only serves as a template and has to be filled in manuelly!
The generated content.json is very basic and may very well not fit your needs so be aware of that. I believe it will work for most people though.

[b][size=4]How to use:[/size]
[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Download and execute [b]ModConverter.exe[/b].
[*]Enter the filepath of your content pack to the console

[*]After execution your content pack contains a manifest.json and content.json file and it should be compatible with SMAPI and Content Patcher!

[/list][b]
[/b]
